amendment: REVISION 2 — supersedes REVISION 1 ONLY on scoring formalization and execution ordering

constants.transport_failure_policy: a transport failure IS a pre-registered trial: it stays in the denominator and is also counted as invalid; it is never removed, retried or replaced
constants.modal_tie_policy: counts equal at the top -> modal is null (a tie never satisfies a modal requirement)

denominator_rule: every n is the number of PRE-REGISTERED trials in that cell; REJECT, schema-invalid, parser-rejected and transport-failed trials all remain in it
transport_failure_policy: a transport failure IS a pre-registered trial: it stays in the denominator and is also counted as invalid; it is never removed, retried or replaced

contrast_rule.CONTRAST_POSITIVE: modal_H=VERIFY AND modal_L=ACCEPT AND delta_verify>=delta_min AND delta_accept>=delta_min AND delta_verify>noise_ceiling AND delta_accept>noise_ceiling
contrast_rule.CONTRAST_NO_MOVEMENT: not positive AND delta_verify<=0 AND delta_accept<=0
contrast_rule.CONTRAST_AMBIGUOUS: everything else (directional but below the bar, or the wrong direction)
contrast_rule.no_post_hoc_choice: both contrasts must clear the bar jointly; selecting the more favourable of VERIFY/ACCEPT is forbidden

negative_control_rule.NEGATIVE_CONTROL_PROBE_INVALID: modal_H != ACCEPT OR modal_L != ACCEPT (the probe itself failed)
negative_control_rule.STATE_EFFECT_NOT_SPECIFIC: probe valid AND (|delta_verify| > noise_ceiling OR |delta_accept| > noise_ceiling)
negative_control_rule.NEGATIVE_CONTROL_HELD: probe valid AND no movement beyond the ceiling

frame_rule.scorer: the SAME classifyContrastV0 and the SAME thresholds for Full, Minimal and Reversal
frame_rule.STATE_EFFECT_FRAME_DEPENDENT: full positive AND minimal NOT positive
frame_rule.MEASUREMENT_FRAME_SUPPRESSED_STATE_SENSI: full NOT positive AND minimal positive
frame_rule.ambiguity_policy: 'not positive' includes ambiguous; ambiguity therefore resolves AGAINST the stronger claim

reversal_rule: the reversal block is scored by the identical classifyContrastV0 over its own cell counts; 'follows belief' means CONTRAST_POSITIVE in the same direction
